doctrine: Pick the cheapest safe path that can complete the task (Model Budget Governor v0.1). Lanes: 0 deterministic local, 1 local AI, 2 free/BYOK/flat-rate cloud (Green or sanitized Amber only). Lane 3 (premium metered handoff) is INTENTIONALLY ABSENT in v0.1 per Manuel 2026-07-04: no premium lane until caps are set in a later version. Work that cannot be done on lanes 0-2 fails closed to human, never to paid.

deterministic-script.notes: node/powershell/python locally; includes esoteric bridge Swiss Ephemeris

local-llm-agora.notes: dormant until ACED-Mobile security gate passes

limits.note: plan usage window; back off when window exhausted

claude-code-session.notes: implementation + independent review; builder and reviewer must differ per constitution

esoteric_timing.notes: bridge :8000; symbolic overlay only, never operational authority

orchestration_mc.notes: Mission Control REST with idempotency keys

memory_ops.notes: cloud lanes FORBIDDEN until ACED-Mem injection/privacy policies pass

code_large.notes: no premium escalation in v0.1; if claude-code-session cannot complete, fail closed to human

curation_batch.notes: playground lane; output passes rights gate + Extraction Gate

review_audit.notes: reviewer must not be the builder

budget_caps.note: v0.1 has NO premium metered lane (Manuel 2026-07-04). All lanes are free or flat-rate plan usage; spend is bounded by the plans themselves, not per-call. A future version may add lane 3 with daily_premium_usd / monthly_premium_usd caps that only Manuel sets.

stop_rules: STOP if privacy class resolves Red and the only capable target is cloud: return human_only.
STOP if the job requires canon repo mutation without a Promotion Packet.
STOP after 2 consecutive failures on a target: escalate to human review, never auto-escalate to a costlier lane.
STOP if a free-tier limit is exhausted: defer to next window, never switch to a paid lane (none exists in v0.1).
STOP if lanes 0-2 cannot complete the job: return human_only; do not invent a premium path.

mission_control_reporting.premium_escalation: artifact per approval with cost estimate before the call
mission_control_reporting.daily_rollup: one artifact per active day: jobs routed per lane, premium spend vs caps
